    {
      "excerpt": "To address these challenges, we propose a framework called BLAST, which balances structures and interactions via large language models and optimal transport for multimodal recommendation.",

      "support_edge_ids": [],
      "support_paper_ids": []
    },
    {
      "excerpt": "To support this study, we build a large multi-style music-to-dance dataset referred to as I-Dance.",

      "support_edge_ids": [],
      "support_paper_ids": []
    },
    {
      "excerpt": "CO3 comprises four key blocks: (1) the Label Correction Block (LC-Block) corrects unreliable labels, (2) the Data Augmentation Block (DA-Block) enhances available data, (3) the Feature Extraction Block (FE-Block) extracts multi-modal features, and (4) the Text-guided Fusion Adapter (TeFu-Adapter) integrates multiple features while mitigating the impact of noisy labels through semantic constraints.",
      "id": "evidence:topic:a3c822691e2f5d396366138cc8393385abfeac65ea58757b5dc9d0983b8d692d",
      "kind": "inferred_topic",
      "raw_sha256": "0aa506ba5b855843188438bba11c9f41e67cce70e36a983495b84872488b454d",

      "source_url": "https://openalex.org/W4393148562",
      "support_edge_ids": [],
      "support_paper_ids": []
    },
    {
      "excerpt": "However, most existing techniques only learn the atomic-level features that reflect strong correlations, while ignoring more complex compositions in multimodal data.",
      "id": "evidence:topic:d47ef898683620bc6846910b4a733148dffeb928c98cc2bead7937e80aeb0381",
      "kind": "inferred_topic",
      "raw_sha256": "0b3874a3fa6ad51ce51fac553271db404e075ecbd1638763835e384bc8b31af1",
      "retrieved_at": "2026-11-07T20:29:43.642825Z",

      "support_edge_ids": [],
      "support_paper_ids": []
    },
    {
      "excerpt": "To learn the distribution of emotions involved in images, most previous works learn coarse semantic knowledge with unbiased filtering.",

      "kind": "inferred_topic",

    {
      "excerpt": "The learned policy is deployed in the target task without additional training.",
      "id": "evidence:topic:1b44775424f90d550bf29da22913d44bd57ded59c2de2357a5d6007b5dc49316",
      "kind": "inferred_topic",

      "source_url": "https://openalex.org/W4285604500",
      "support_edge_ids": [],
      "support_paper_ids": []
    },
    {
      "excerpt": "We design a novel counterfactual intrinsic reward through the use of either a forward model or successor features that can learn an interaction skill between a pair of objects given as a goal.",

      "source_url": "https://openalex.org/W4393159751",
      "support_edge_ids": [],
      "support_paper_ids": []
    },
    {
      "excerpt": "In this paper, we specifically focus on the online class-incremental setting where a model needs to learn new classes continually from an online data stream.",
      "id": "evidence:topic:35d5287d809fdae54f2e5748e88f209b76e678a18b74efd740950d41dcef12a2",
      "kind": "inferred_topic",
      "raw_sha256": "54a13846a12337c1bd8eef802412dabdb7db12958eb06f0c8dac19d71c7136be",
      "retrieved_at": "2026-11-07T20:25:02.158281Z",
      "source_locator": "openalex-request:75b58b36f3790eb5b485055a694f550339a2bfb5835284bee0482c9becb1663a#results[0];abstract[420:577]",
      "source_url": "https://openalex.org/W3175853876",
      "support_edge_ids": [],
      "support_paper_ids": []
    },
    {
      "excerpt": "Meta reinforcement learning (meta-RL) aims to learn a policy solving a set of training tasks simultaneously and quickly adapting to new tasks.",
      "id": "evidence:topic:3ac9ca0c8816cac5d4faccc79afe263e6763c677ed92e0617a3f9356dd316870",
      "kind": "inferred_topic",
      "raw_sha256": "d5bef9ed4dd9cf5515488ae8926aa8a0878c688a749c7816e1dbfdff839ea747",
      "retrieved_at": "2026-11-07T20:26:00.985321Z",
      "source_locator": "openalex-request:430c4612cde3e7f8bee79cfd9fabb58bd59f10ecefdc412bde17ee47c18614ca#results[32];abstract[0:142]",
      "source_url": "https://openalex.org/W4283822150",
      "support_edge_ids": [],
      "support_paper_ids": []
    },
    {
      "excerpt": "We find that our agent achieves performance closest to the oracle in terms of both learning speed and maximum success rate.",

      "kind": "inferred_topic",
      "raw_sha256": "ff06d1ac9758308e9d9c446438ffd59512e85b019a621d31a203f2e31bb9c2a3",

      "support_edge_ids": [],
